mapper.sql: a.id, a.archive_no, a.processing_task_id, t.task_no, t.task_name, t.processing_type, a.tile_set_id, a.archive_name, a.archive_format, a.archive_status, a.current_stage, a.total_file_count, a.processed_file_count, a.total_bytes, a.processed_bytes, a.archive_size_bytes, a.sha256, a.operator_id, a.download_count, a.last_download_time, a.error_message, a.version, CASE WHEN a.archive_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 100 WHEN a.total_bytes > 0 THEN CAST((a.processed_bytes::NUMERIC * 100) / a.total_bytes AS INTEGER) WHEN a.total_file_count > 0 THEN CAST((a.processed_file_count::NUMERIC * 100) / a.total_file_count AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END AS packing_percent, CASE WHEN a.archive_status = 'COMPLETED' AND a.storage_key IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS download_available, a.start_time, a.finish_time, a.create_time, a.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_tile_set_archive a JOIN ocean_gis.gis_processing_task t ON t.id = a.processing_task_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.archive_no = #{archiveNo}
